Tutorial_Page1_Text:
This plugin helps you identify which items in your inventory are missing from your Glamour Dresser and Armoire.

To get started, you MUST physically open the Glamour Dresser or Armoire in the game.

Once opened, click the "Read Dresser/Armoire" button in the main window to scan your currently stored items.
Tutorial_Page2_Text:
After scanning, the plugin will categorize your items:

1. New Appearances: Items whose visual appearance (3D mesh + base textures) is NOT stored. The plugin is a perfectionist here; even a color difference in a zipper makes it "New".

2. Duplicates: Items that share the exact same base 3D mesh with something already stored. The plugin is aggressive here to help you clear space, ignoring texture differences.
Tutorial_Page3_Text:
Because of how Final Fantasy XIV recycles 3D models, you might disagree with the plugin's categorization.

You have absolute control! Just Right-Click any item in the list and select "Ignore as New Appearance" or "Ignore as Duplicate". The plugin will stop bothering you about that specific item.
Tutorial_Page4_Text:
Don't worry about making mistakes!

You can enable the "Ignored Items" tab in the plugin settings (/glamourchecker config) to review everything you have ignored and restore them at any time.

You are ready to go!
